Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]2 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.22 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]19 |speed = 3.5 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Unit Level 0+}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Unit Level 0+}} (Collision Only) |flying = N/A }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Just a regular dude that shoots enemies with a submachine gun at a medium range.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Lackey''', internally referred to as '''KingpinHenchman''', is one of the two first units spawned by the [[Kingpin]]. It receives three upgrades, one when the [[Kingpin]] is upgraded to Level 4B or Level 5A, one when upgraded to Level 5B or Level 6A and one when upgraded to Level 6B. Like most other units, it starts from one of the entrances of the map and moves towards the exit. Whenever there is a detectable enemy in its range, it will stop moving to attack it. It will continue walking if there are no enemies in its range for a few seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Lackey''' has dark skin, brown hair and a light smirk. Wears a grey coat with dark grey stripes, white shirt, dark brown stripes pants, brown shoes with gold laces, a shiny leather buckle, golden shades and a grey hat with a red band. Wields an Uzi to attack enemies. ==Stats== {{neow| $DPS$ = Damage / Firerate $RDPS$ = Health / Spawn Time

}} ==Strategy== *The '''Lackey''' has the fastest spawn time out of all offensive units, though it also has the lowest DPS out of them, so it is optimal to use it for unit stacking. *This unit pairs well with the [[Field Medic]] from the [[Mercenary Base]], as it can shield it from damage. *While the [[Kingpin]] does not have hidden detection, the '''Lackey''' does, meaning it can be used to deal with [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies. **It cannot be used for flying or lead detection as it lacks them. Other units or the [[Kingpin]] itself should be used instead. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} KingpinThumbnail.png|'''Lackey''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} KingpinBoomerangUpdateIcon.png|'''Lackey''' on the game icon. }} ==Update History== *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **'''Lackey''' added. *'''14 August 2026''' - [[v2.6.0]] **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 3''' ****Damage decreased from 8 to 7. ****Range decreased from 27 to 25. {{TowerNavBox}}
